hero.title: Power, farms
hero.text: Stone from nothing, herds in a single block, lava turned into grid power, and a clockwork shopkeeper who sells your goods to villagers. Every machine here is taught from the first block to full automation.

intro.title: Into the workshop
body: Your Create factory turns, crushes and mixes. But it still wants stone you dig by hand, a field of wheat, a pen of cows and a chest that fills too soon. This mod closes those gaps, one machine at a time.

Start small: an Upgrade Template, a Cobblestone Generator, a bigger chest. Then fluids from nothing, dust pressed into emeralds, herds and hordes kept in a single block. Then lava turned into Forge Energy, carried on hanging wires to motors and batteries across your base. And at the end, three Withers held in a field that must never lose power.
Every page answers the same five questions: what it does, why you'd want it, when it's worth building, how it fits with everything else, and the mistakes that cost players an evening.

notes.title: Electric Lights
notes.body: Lamp posts, wall, ceiling and hanging lamps, strips, edge trim, festoons and a Floodlight, all run off the Power Lines. Cut them from a **Light Assembly** in a stonecutter, colour them with a dye that isn't used up, and switch whole circuits with a **Light Switch**.

notes.title: Something in the ruins
notes.body: Rings of broken walls, in the Overworld and on the End's outer islands. Something kneels at the middle of each. It is not a statue.

notes.title: Fish Tanks
notes.body: Fish, squid and axolotls now breed underwater in one block on **Fish Food**. Cages and tanks got their Ponder scenes, Display Links, Dispensers and advancements.

notes.title: Monster Cages
notes.body: Five cages, from a zombie horde to three Withers in a containment field, with Iron Jars, **Monster Chow** and the **Monstrous** enchantment.

notes.title: Batteries
notes.body: A Battery stores FE for the Power Lines. Fill a 3×3 column with them and they become an Industrial Battery, up to nine blocks tall.

notes.title: 2.5.0: Fluid and Power Lines
notes.body: The mod's own pipes and wires, in copper and brass, replace Pipez: fittings clip onto the line, and wires hang in spans between posts.

notes.title: Biomes
notes.body: New places are on the drawing board. They'll get their own section of the codex.

progressionIntro: Four stages, from your first andesite machines to a caged Wither. Each column lists the goals that mark the stage and the key builds. Tick goals off as you go (they're remembered in this browser), and hover a build to light up everything it needs first.

progression.title: Early game
progression.summary: Steady stone, food and storage without leaving the base.
progression.needs: Create's andesite machines and a sequenced assembly line.
goals: Make an [[upgrade-template]] on a sequenced assembly line
Upgrade a chest with a [[chest-upgrades|Copper Chest Upgrade]]
Catch an animal in a [[capture-bottle]] and start an [[animal-pen]]

progression.title: Mid game
progression.summary: Fluids from nothing, gems from dust, and your first Forge Energy.
progression.needs: Brass, a Blaze Burner you can keep lit, and Crushing Wheels.
goals: Press your first Emerald in the [[pressure-crucible]]

progression.title: Advanced
progression.summary: Grid-scale power, automated trading and the big farms.
progression.needs: Precision Mechanisms, a steady lava supply and plenty of brass.
goals: Send a [[trade-bot]] out to trade with seated villagers

progression.title: End game
progression.summary: The biggest builds, and the one that must never lose power.
progression.needs: Netherite, FE Coils and a power grid you trust.
goals: Breed a [[blue-axolotl]] in a Fish Tank
